title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
description: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert is a staged performance by actors, singers, and orchestra, created by Alice Wiley Pickett, that portrays composer Maurice Ravel alongside Claude Debussy and George Gershwin. It follows Ravel's rise to fame in early 20th-century Paris with both comic and poignant moments. The Springfield Symphony Orchestra presents it on Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
